title: Gripper 6: Mobile manipulator (MuJoCo)
description: Gripper 5's soft gripper on a six-axis robot arm, on an omniwheel platform that carries a crate of groceries: drive the robot to the shelves with the joystick or the arrow keys, then steer the gripper as in Gripper 5 while the arm follows by inverse kinematics, and stock the empty places.
